quote: we replace our sinusoidal positional encoding with learned positional embeddings, and observe nearly identical results to the base model
claim: 模型变体实验显示，单头注意力比最佳设置差 0.9 BLEU，头数过多时质量也会下降 [S6.SS2.p2]；用学习式位置嵌入替换正弦位置编码，结果几乎相同 [S6.SS2.p3]。

quote: The encoder is composed of a stack of $N=6$ identical layers.
claim: Transformer 沿用编码器-解码器整体结构，编码器和解码器各由 N=6 个相同层堆叠而成 [S3.p2][S3.SS1.SSS0.Px1.p1][S3.SS1.SSS0.Px2.p1]。

quote: This inherently sequential nature precludes parallelization within training examples, which becomes critical at longer sequence lengths
claim: 论文要解决的问题是：循环模型沿输入输出序列的符号位置逐步计算，这种固有的顺序性阻碍了训练样本内部的并行化，在序列较长时尤为关键 [S1.p2]。

quote: self-attention could be restricted to considering only a neighborhood of size $r$ in the input sequence centered around the respective output position
claim: 对于涉及很长序列的任务，作者提出可将自注意力限制在输入序列中以相应输出位置为中心、大小为 r 的邻域内，并计划在未来工作中进一步研究该做法 [S4.p4]。

quote: Since our model contains no recurrence and no convolution, in order for the model to make use of the order of the sequence, we must inject some information about the relative or absolute position of the tokens in the sequence.
claim: 由于模型不含循环和卷积，作者在输入嵌入中加入正弦位置编码以利用序列顺序 [S3.SS5.p1][S3.SS5.p2]。

quote: The “Base” and “Large” models are directly adopted from BERT and we add the larger “Huge” model.
claim: 模型变体基于 BERT 配置，包括 Base、Large 和新增的 Huge，并用 ViT-L/16 等记号表示模型规模与 patch 大小 [S4.SS1.p3]。

quote: We also evaluate on the 19-task VTAB classification suite.
claim: 预训练使用 ILSVRC-2012 ImageNet（1k 类、1.3M 图像）、ImageNet-21k（21k 类、14M 图像）和 JFT（18k 类、303M 高分辨率图像），并迁移到 ImageNet、ImageNet-ReaL、CIFAR-10/100、Oxford-IIIT Pets、Oxford Flowers-102 以及 19 任务的 VTAB 分类套件 [S4.SS1.p1][S4.SS1.p2]。

quote: Position embeddings are added to the patch embeddings to retain positional information.
claim: 模型加入可学习的一维位置嵌入，编码器由多头自注意力和 MLP 交替组成，每个 block 前用 LayerNorm、后接残差连接 [S3.SS1.p3][S3.SS1.p4]。

quote: we flatten the patches and map to $D$ dimensions with a trainable linear projection (Eq. 1).
claim: ViT 将图像 \(\mathbf{x}\in\mathbb{R}^{H\times W\times C}\) 切分为固定大小的二维 patch，展平后经可训练线性投影映射到维度 \(D\)，得到 patch embeddings [S3.SS1.p1]。

quote: Transformers lack some of the inductive biases inherent to CNNs, such as translation equivariance and locality, and therefore do not generalize well when trained on insufficient amounts of data.
claim: 作者指出，在中型数据集（如 ImageNet）上不加强正则化训练时，ViT 精度比同规模 ResNet 低几个百分点，并认为这可能是因为 Transformer 缺少 CNN 固有的平移等变性和局部性等归纳偏置，在数据不足时泛化不佳 [S1.p4]。

quote: a retriever $p_{\eta}(z|x)$ with parameters $\eta$ that returns (top-K truncated) distributions over text passages given a query $x$
claim: RAG 使用输入序列检索文本文档，并将其作为生成目标序列的额外上下文 [S2.p1]。

quote: RAG-Sequence’s generations are more diverse than RAG-Token’s, and both are significantly more diverse than BART without needing any diversity-promoting decoding.
claim: RAG 生成比 BART 更多样 [S4.SS5.SSS0.Px1.p1]。

quote: Here, we bring hybrid parametric and non-parametric memory to the “workhorse of NLP,” i.e. sequence-to-sequence (seq2seq) models.
claim: 论文要解决预训练语言模型在知识密集型任务上的局限：它们难以扩展或修正记忆、无法直接提供预测依据，并可能产生“幻觉” [S1.p1]。

quote: REALM and ORQA, two recently introduced models that combine masked language models with a differentiable retriever, have shown promising results, but have only explored open-domain extractive question answering.
claim: 论文要解决预训练语言模型在知识密集型任务上的局限：它们难以扩展或修正记忆、无法直接提供预测依据，并可能产生“幻觉” [S1.p1]。

quote: keep the document encoder (and index) fixed, only fine-tuning the query encoder $\text{BERT}_{q}$ and the BART generator.
claim: 训练时联合微调查询编码器和 BART 生成器，文档编码器与索引保持固定 [S2.SS4.p1]。

quote: We evaluate our method on the ImageNet 2012 classification dataset that consists of 1000 classes.
claim: 论文在 ImageNet 2012 分类数据集（1000 类，128 万训练图像，5 万验证图像，10 万测试图像）上评估方法，报告 top-1 和 top-5 错误率 [S4.SS1.p1]。

quote: This leads to 3.57% top-5 error on the test set (Table 5). This entry won the 1st place in ILSVRC 2015.
claim: 152 层 ResNet 单模型 top-5 验证误差为 4.49%，六模型集成在测试集上取得 3.57% top-5 误差，赢得 ILSVRC 2015 第一名 [S4.SS1.p16]。

quote: this $10^{3}$ -layer network is able to achieve training error $<$ 0.1% (Fig. 6, right). Its test error is still fairly good (7.93%, Table 6).
claim: 1202 层网络训练误差低于 0.1%，但测试误差为 7.93%，差于 110 层网络 [S4.SS2.p8][S4.SS2.p9]。

quote: When deeper networks are able to start converging, a degradation problem has been exposed: with the network depth increasing, accuracy gets saturated (which might be unsurprising) and then degrades rapidly.
claim: 论文要解决的问题是：当网络能够开始收敛时，随着深度增加会出现退化问题——准确率饱和后迅速下降，且这种退化并非由过拟合引起，给适当深的模型增加更多层反而导致更高的训练误差 [S1.p3]。

quote: our ResNets manage to overcome the optimization difficulty and demonstrate accuracy gains when the depth increases.
claim: 在 CIFAR-10 上，ResNet 克服了优化困难并随深度增加获得准确率提升，110 层网络达到 6.43% 错误率 [S4.SS2.p5][S4.SS2.p6]。

quote: Our rule-based reward system mainly consists of two types of rewards: accuracy rewards and format rewards.
claim: 奖励由规则化的准确率奖励和格式奖励组成，不使用神经奖励模型 [S2.SS2.p1][S2.SS2.p4]。

quote: the structural output capabilities of DeepSeek-R1 remain suboptimal compared to existing models.
claim: 作者明确承认 DeepSeek-R1 存在多项能力局限：结构化输出能力仍不理想，且无法利用搜索引擎、计算器等工具 [S6.p3]；token 效率仍有优化空间，简单问题上仍观察到过度推理（overthinking）[S6.p4]；目前主要针对中英文优化，处理其他语言时可能出现语言混合 [S6.p5]；对提示敏感，few-shot 提示会持续降低其性能 [S6.p6]；由于评估耗时长影响 RL 效率，软件工程任务未大规模应用 RL，在软件工程基准上未显著超越 DeepSeek-V3 [S6.p7]。

quote: A similar trend is observed on coding algorithm tasks, such as LiveCodeBench and Codeforces, where reasoning-focused models dominate these benchmarks.
claim: DeepSeek-R1 在数学任务上与 OpenAI-o1-1217 表现相当，在编程算法任务上推理模型占优 [A4.SS2.SSS0.Px1.p3]。

quote: DeepSeek-R1-Zero increasingly exhibits advanced reasoning strategies such as reflective reasoning and systematic exploration of alternative solutions
claim: 训练过程中模型自然涌现出反思推理和系统性探索替代方案等高级推理策略，并出现“aha moment” [S2.SS3.p5]。

quote: we use a sampling temperature of $0.6$ and a top- $p$ value of $0.95$ to generate $k$ responses
claim: 评估时使用 pass@k，采样温度 0.6、top-p 0.95，AIME 和 GPQA 使用 k=64，MATH 和 CodeForces 使用 k=16，LCB 使用 k=8 [A4.SS1.SSS0.Px4.p2]。

quote: we suppress the generation of the end-of-thinking token delimiter and optionally append the string “Wait”
claim: 二是测试时扩展，提出 budget forcing：当思考 token 超过上限时强制插入结束思考分隔符，当希望延长思考时抑制该分隔符并追加“Wait” [S3.SS1.SSS0.Px1.p1]。

quote: we evaluate with a temperature of 0 (greedy) and measure accuracy
claim: 评估使用 AIME24（30 题）、MATH500（500 题）和 GPQA Diamond（198 题）三个基准，默认温度 0 并测量准确率 [S4.SS1.SSS0.Px2.p1]。

quote: our model s1-32B exceeds o1-preview on competition math questions by up to 27% (MATH and AIME24)
claim: s1-32B 在竞赛数学题上超过 o1-preview 最多 27%（MATH 和 AIME24）[abstract]。

quote: We focus on sequential scaling as intuitively we believe it should scale better
claim: 作者将测试时扩展方法分为顺序式与并行式，并聚焦顺序式 [S3.SS1.p1]。

quote: Suppressing the end-of-thinking token delimiter too often can lead the model into repetitive loops instead of continued reasoning.
claim: 此外，抑制结束思考分隔符过于频繁可能导致模型陷入重复循环而非继续推理 [S4.SS2.SSS0.Px1.p1]。

quote: Complex reasoning has long been considered one of the most challenging capabilities to instill in large language models (LLMs).
claim: 作者指出，传统范式通常需要数万到数十万示例，基于两个假设：掌握复杂认知过程需要大量监督示范，且监督微调主要导致记忆而非真正泛化 [S1.p1]。

quote: we selected the highest-scoring solution for each problem, ranked these pairs by quality score, and extracted the top 800 to form the LIMO Dataset.
claim: 随后用 DeepSeek R1、DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-32B 和 QwQ-32B 生成推理链，并按 elaborated reasoning、self-verification、exploratory approach、adaptive granularity 四个维度加权评分，选出最高分的 800 条构成 LIMO 数据集 [S3.SS1.SSS2.p1][S3.SS1.SSS2.p6][S3.SS1.SSS2.p7]。

quote: On OlympiadBench, LIMO achieves 67.6% accuracy, significantly outperforming QwQ-32B-Preview (58.5%) and the base model (45.3%).
claim: 在分布外任务上，LIMO 在 OlympiadBench 达 67.6%，超过 QwQ-32B-Preview 的 58.5% 和基座的 45.3%；CHMath 为 84.2% 对 68.5%，GradeSchool 为 76.2% 对 63.8%；GPQA 达 70.7%，接近 OpenAI-o1-preview 的 73.3% [S6.SS2.SSS0.Px2.p1]。

quote: These include OpenAI-o1-preview, a large language model that has demonstrated advanced mathematical reasoning abilities across various complex tasks; QwQ-32B-Preview
claim: 对比基线包括 OpenAI-o1-preview、QwQ-32B-Preview、Qwen2.5-32B-Instruct，以及用 OpenThoughts-114k 和 NuminaMath-100k 微调的同骨干模型 [S6.SS1.p1][S6.SS1.p2]。

quote: we construct novel multilingual benchmarks using recent examination problems: CHMath (2024 Chinese High School Mathematics League), Gaokao (China’s 2024 College Entrance Exam), Kaoyan (Chinese Graduate School Entrance Exams), and GradeSchool
claim: 论文在域内基准 AIME24、MATH500、AMC23 上评估，并在三类分布外基准上测试：OlympiadBench 等数学竞赛、CHMath/Gaokao/Kaoyan/GradeSchool 等中文新构建基准、以及 Minerva 和 GPQA 等多学科基准 [S5.SS0.SSS0.Px1.p1][S5.SS0.SSS0.Px2.p1]。

quote: Environment feedback should be informative but concise.
claim: 设计遵循四条原则：动作应简单易懂、动作应紧凑高效、环境反馈应信息丰富但简洁、guardrails 应能缓解错误传播并加速恢复 [S2.p5]。

quote: We primarily evaluate on the SWE-bench dataset, which includes $2,294$ task instances from $12$ different repositories of popular Python packages.
claim: 论文主要在 SWE-bench 上评估，该数据集包含来自 12 个流行 Python 包的 2,294 个任务实例；消融与分析在 SWE-bench Lite 上进行，该子集包含 300 个实例，聚焦自包含的功能性 bug 修复 [S4.p1]。

quote: SWE-agent w/ GPT-4 Turbo achieves the best performance all-around, successfully solving $12.47$ % ( $286$ / $2,294$) of the full SWE-bench test set and $18.00$ % ( $54$ / $300$) of the Lite split.
claim: SWE-agent w/ GPT-4 Turbo 在所有系统中表现最佳，解决了完整 SWE-bench 测试集的 12.47%（286/2,294）和 Lite 子集的 18.00%（54/300）[S5.p1]。

quote: At each step, SWE-agent generates a thought and a command, then incorporates the feedback from the command’s execution in the environment
claim: ACI 包含搜索/导航、文件查看器、文件编辑器和上下文管理等组件，agent 每步生成一个 thought 和一个 command，并将命令执行反馈纳入后续输入 [S3.p1]。

quote: The ACI uses guardrails to prevent common mistakes, and an agent receives specific, concise feedback about a command’s effects at every turn.
claim: 论文提出 SWE-agent，一个由 LM 与 ACI 组成的系统，其 ACI 提供一小组简单动作用于查看、搜索和编辑文件，并配有 guardrails 防止常见错误，每一步都向 agent 返回具体而简洁的反馈 [S1.p3]。

quote: We also evaluate Quiet-STaR on C4, a widely used LM pretraining corpus with more diverse text
claim: 大部分实验在 OpenWebMath 上训练，该语料偏重技术网页，作者预期其包含更高密度的需要推理的 token [S5.p2]。

quote: methods for allowing LMs to learn from their reasoning (e.g.,) have focused on solving individual tasks or predefined sets of tasks (e.g.,).
claim: 论文要解决的问题是：能否不依赖精心整理的问答数据集，而是利用语言建模任务本身，从任意文本中学习推理 [S1.p1][S1.p2]。

quote: We perform most of our experiments by training on OpenWebMath, a crawl that emphasizes more technical webpages.
claim: 大部分实验在 OpenWebMath 上训练，该语料偏重技术网页，作者预期其包含更高密度的需要推理的 token [S5.p2]。

quote: there is a disproportionate improvement on more difficult tokens.
claim: 思考对困难 token 的提升不成比例地更大，而大多数 token 基本不受影响 [S5.SS2.p1][A7.p1]。

quote: We use REINFORCE to provide a learning signal to rationales based on their impact on future-token prediction.
claim: 方法分三步：在输入序列所有 token 位置并行生成理由，并插入可学习的 <|startofthought|> 和 <|endofthought|> 标记 [S4.SS1.p1]；用混合头决定后理由预测与基础预测的融合权重 [S4.SS1.p1]；用 REINFORCE 根据理由对未来 token 预测的提升来优化理由生成 [S4.SS1.p1]。

quote: However, when interacting with LLMs, users and developers often restrict models to making only one attempt when solving a problem.
claim: 作者指出，尽管训练计算扩展已显著提升模型能力，但推理时通常只允许模型进行一次尝试，对推理计算的投入相对有限 [S1.p2]。

quote: When holding the total number of inference FLOPs constant, we find that on some datasets (e.g. MATH), coverage is maximized with a smaller model and more samples, while on others (e.g CodeContests) it is better to sample fewer times from a larger model.
claim: 此外，重复采样可能使较弱模型与更多样本的组合在性能或成本上优于更强模型的单次尝试 [S1.p9]。

quote: 2. Multi-Turn Interactions: Despite automatic verification tools being available when solving CodeContests and MiniF2F problems, we use only a single-turn setup where models generate a solution without any ability to iterate on it.
claim: 作者指出，实验仅探索了简单版本的重复采样，即所有尝试使用完全相同的提示和超参数独立生成，未探索解决方案多样性、多轮交互或从先前尝试中学习等改进方向 [S5.p2][S5.p3]。

quote: 1) We generate many independent candidate solutions for a given problem by sampling from an LLM with a positive temperature. 2) We use a domain-specific verifier (ex. unit tests for code) to select a final answer from the generated samples.
claim: 论文采用重复采样方法：对每个问题，使用正温度从语言模型独立采样多个候选解，然后使用领域特定的验证器（如代码的单元测试、Lean4 证明检查器）从生成的样本中选择最终答案 [S1.F1]。

quote: When solving MATH problems with Llama-3-8B-Instruct, coverage increases from 82.9% with 100 samples to 98.44% with 10,000 samples.
claim: 在 MATH 上，Llama-3-8B-Instruct 的覆盖率从 100 个样本的 82.9% 提升到 10,000 个样本的 98.44%，但多数投票或奖励模型选择的最佳性能仅从 40.50% 提升到 41.41% [S1.p10]。

quote: humans can generally perform a new language task from only a few examples or from simple instructions
claim: 作者指出，人类通常只需少量示例或简单指令即可完成新的语言任务，而当前 NLP 系统仍难以做到这一点 [abstract]。

quote: GPT-3 achieves 64.3% accuracy on TriviaQA in the zero-shot setting, 68.0% in the one-shot setting, and 71.2% in the few-shot setting
claim: GPT-3 在零样本和单样本设置下取得有希望的结果，少样本设置下有时可与甚至偶尔超过最先进的微调模型 [S1.p11]。

quote: typically 10 to 100
claim: 论文在少样本、单样本和零样本三种条件下评估模型，少样本通常允许 10 到 100 个示例放入上下文窗口 [S1.p9]。

quote: ambiguity about whether few-shot learning actually learns new tasks “from scratch” at inference time, or if it simply recognizes and identifies tasks that it has learned during training
claim: 此外，作者承认少样本学习存在不确定性：不清楚模型是在推理时真正从头学习新任务，还是仅识别训练中已学过的任务 [S5.p6]。

quote: This includes natural language inference tasks like the ANLI dataset, and some reading comprehension datasets like RACE or QuAC
claim: 同时，论文发现部分任务上少样本性能仍不佳，包括 ANLI 等自然语言推理任务以及 RACE、QuAC 等阅读理解数据集 [S1.p13]。

quote: On MMLU, in line with English MMLU results shown above, Llama 3 405B falls behind GPT-4o by 2%.
claim: Llama 3 405B 在 MMLU 上落后 GPT-4o 约 2%，但在 MGSM 上平均达到 91.6%，优于大多数其他模型 [S5.SS2.SSS4.p4]。

quote: We leverage MMLU and MMLU-Pro to evaluate Llama 3’s capability on knowledge-based question answering.
claim: 后训练模型在 MMLU、MMLU-Pro、IFEval、HumanEval、MBPP、MultiPL-E、MGSM 等基准上进行了评估 [S5.SS2.SSS1.p2][S5.SS2.SSS3.p2][S5.SS2.SSS4.p1]。

quote: We find that Llama 3 405B outperforms most other models on MGSM, achieving an average of 91.6%.
claim: Llama 3 405B 在 MMLU 上落后 GPT-4o 约 2%，但在 MGSM 上平均达到 91.6%，优于大多数其他模型 [S5.SS2.SSS4.p4]。

quote: we pre-train a model with 405B parameters on 15.6T tokens using a context window of 8K tokens.
claim: 开发分为预训练和后训练两个主要阶段：预训练在约 15T 多语言 tokens 上进行下一词预测，随后进行长上下文预训练和退火 [S2.p2][S3.SS4.p1]；后训练通过多轮监督微调（SFT）和直接偏好优化（DPO）进行对齐 [S4.p1]。

quote: These models are still under development and not yet ready for release.
claim: 作者承认多模态模型仍在积极开发中，尚未准备好发布 [S2.p6]。

quote: The overall model architecture of Qwen2.5-VL consists of three components:
claim: Qwen2.5-VL 的架构由大语言模型、视觉编码器和基于 MLP 的视觉-语言合并器三部分组成 [S2.SS1.p1]。

quote: we are committed to exploring fine-grained perception capabilities, aiming to establish a robust foundation for LVLMs and create an agentic amplifier for real-world applications.
claim: Qwen2.5-VL 旨在探索细粒度感知能力，为 LVLMs 建立坚实基础，并打造面向真实应用的智能体放大器 [S1.p1]。

quote: Intermediate reasoning steps may fail to adequately integrate visual information, either by ignoring relevant visual cues or misinterpreting them.
claim: 作者指出，在将思维链推理应用于视觉语言模型时，中间推理步骤可能无法充分整合视觉信息，要么忽略相关视觉线索，要么误解它们；尽管开发了基于规则和模型驱动的过滤策略来验证中间推理步骤，实现最优的模态对齐仍是一个持续存在的挑战，需要进一步改进 [S2.SS3.SSS3.p4]。

quote: Qwen2.5-VL introduces a key improvement: aligning the temporal component of MRoPE with absolute time.
claim: 模型在空间上动态将不同尺寸图像转换为相应长度的 token 序列，在时间上引入动态帧率训练和绝对时间编码，将 MRoPE 的时间 ID 与绝对时间对齐 [S2.SS1.SSS2.p2][S2.SS1.SSS2.p3][S2.SS1.SSS3.p3]。

quote: we conducted extensive experiments across a diverse range of datasets.
claim: 评估覆盖通用视觉问答、文档理解与 OCR、空间理解、视频理解与定位以及智能体等多个基准 [S3.SS3.SSS1.p1][S3.SS3.SSS2.p1][S3.SS3.SSS3.p1][S3.SS3.SSS4.p1][S3.SS3.SSS5.p1]。

quote: • Movie Gen Audio. A 13B parameter foundation model for video- and text-to-audio generation
